Visual inspection especially inside the cable loop, cable holders and at the platforms.
Visual inspection for cleanliness and damages. Inspect ladder or structure for signs of abrasion.
Check the quantity (inspection shell) of grease and fill up the grease tank.
Visual check for sliding of main shaft and hollow shaft. Mark shaft and disk with one line and the actual date for later inspection.
The functioning of mechanical pump has to be checked by specialized gearbox persons only.
Take a 100 ml oil sample for analysis. Refer to Procedure WDOO030.
Do not overfill the gear box. Visual check of oil level through oil level glass when the gearbox has been standing still for 30 minutes (for the oil to settle down). Refer to Procedure WDOO030.

The guaranteed lifetime for hoses is 5 years. After this period the visual inspections should be more frequent and accurate. An exchange is necessary if found damaged, cut. Check manufacturing date marked on each hose.
Minimum interval: half-yearly; recommended interval: monthly.
